sync.next.cancelled: Nothing to do. This entry is kept for the audit trail.

tour.title: Getting Started
tour.skipped: Tour skipped. Restart it any time from Help → Product tour.
tour.welcome.title: Welcome to Medical Shop
tour.welcome.body: Manage stock, sales and payments from one place, and keep working when the connection drops. This quick tour shows you how.
tour.dashboard.title: Your shop at a glance
tour.dashboard.body: Home shows your shop’s stock, sales, payments and alerts. Anything that changes stock counts asks you to confirm before it is saved, so a mistaken tap can’t change your inventory.
tour.offline.title: Working offline
tour.offline.body: When the connection drops, sales, stock movements and profile edits are saved on this phone and sync later. Payments and anything that needs the server to confirm wait until you’re back online.
tour.help.title: Help, support and language
tour.help.body: Raise a support ticket from Help. When you open it from an error, the operation ID is added for you so support can find it fast. Change the app language any time from the language button on Home.
tour.sync.title: Sync status
tour.finish.title: You’re all set
tour.finish.body: You can restart this tour any time from Help → Product tour.
